'''Nogometni klub Bratstvo Gračanica''' or simply '''NK Bratstvo Gračanica''' is a professional [[association football]] club from the city of [[Gračanica, Bosnia and Herzegovina|Gračanica]] that is situated in [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]].

Bratstvo currently plays in the [[First League of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina]] and plays its home matches on the Luke Stadium in Gračanica, which has a capacity of 3,000 seats.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nsfbih.ba/stranica/nk-bratstvo|title=NK Bratstvo Gračanica|accessdate=16 July 2019|language=Bosnian|website=nsfbih.ba|archive-date=19 March 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160319192421/http://nsfbih.ba/stranica/nk-bratstvo|url-status=dead}}</ref>"}}
